parent_id = #{parentId}, menu_name = #{menuName}, menu_type = #{menuType}, route_path = #{routePath}, component = #{component}, icon = #{icon}, perm_code = #{permCode}, sort_no = #{sortNo}, visible = #{visible}, state = #{state}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = now()

mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT m.menu_id, m.parent_id, m.menu_name, m.menu_type, m.route_path, m.component, m.icon, m.perm_code, m.sort_no, m.visible, m.state, m.created_by, m.created_at, m.updated_by, m.updated_at, m.deleted, m.remark FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = false AND m.state = 'normal' AND m.menu_type <> 'button' ORDER BY m.sort_no ASC

SELECT DISTINCT m.perm_code FROM sys_menu m INNER JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.menu_id = m.menu_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = rm.role_id INNER JOIN sys_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.deleted = false AND r.state = 'normal' WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND m.deleted = false AND m.state = 'normal' AND m.perm_code IS NOT NULL AND m.perm_code <> ''
